description: A request that sends ARQ to a group address, by the bind default or explicitly, is rejected with reason 6 (Broadcast Not Allowed); non-ARQ to the same group is accepted.
note: Accepted non-ARQ requests go to the DTS queue, which has no observable effect until the planner (P3-4); a burst_started first keeps the channel busy, so a CSMA MAC holds in SENSE (K-0066) and the trace stays valid once Annex K lands. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
